statement.text: Frozen model for FP-0.35: Weil quadratic form Q_W on L^2(-L,L) with L=7/20, Suzuki convention (2.5)/(2.11), Archimedean kernel r, and first prime layer P_{2,L} = -(log2/sqrt(2)) C_{log2,L}.

Single-step overlap decomposition (Theorem 1): For b/2 < L < b, the operator C_{b,L} = S_{b,L} + S_{b,L}* decomposes as the exchange matrix on L^2(I_-) oplus L^2(I_+) plus zero on L^2(I_0), with spectrum {-1,0,1} all of infinite multiplicity and operator norm 1.

Corollary 1 (first prime layer exact sign): In the window (log2/2, log3/2), the first prime operator -(log2/sqrt(2)) C_{log2,L} has spectrum {-c_2, 0, +c_2} with c_2 = log2/sqrt(2), all of infinite multiplicity. The layer is indefinite and non-compact.

Corollary 2 (no L^2 small perturbation at threshold): For any L in (log2/2, log2), ||C_{log2,L}|| = 1 regardless of the support length 2L-log2, so the first prime layer is not an operator-norm small perturbation even as its support shrinks to measure zero.

Endpoint potential absorption (Theorem 2): For L=7/20, the log endpoint potential V(x) = -(1/2)log(1-x^2) satisfies |<C_{tau,1}w,w>| <= ||w||^2_{E_- union E_+} <= kappa_edge(L)^{-1} <Vw,w>, where kappa_edge(L) = (1/2)log(1/(2*epsilon)) > 0, epsilon = 2 - log2/L. Hence V + P_{2,L} >= (1 - c_2/kappa_edge(L)) V >= 0.

Pure rational absorption certificate (Theorem 3): At L=7/20, c_2/kappa_edge(7/20) < 31/100, hence V + P_{2,7/20} >= (69/100) V >= 0. Certificate: log2 in (842/1215, 23581/34020), epsilon < 34/1701 < 1/41, e^16 < (87/32)^16 < (1701/68)^5 < (1/(2*epsilon))^5, giving kappa_edge > 8/5; c_2 < 23581/47628 < 62/125; ratio 62/125 divided by 8/5 = 31/100.

Potential redistribution (Corollary 3.1): The full scaled form satisfies bar_q_{7/20} >= tilde_q_{7/20} := T + (69/100)V + K_{7/20} - c_{7/20}I in the closed-form ordering. Proving tilde_q >= L_0*I with L_0 > 0 is sufficient for FP-0.35.

First-prime Legendre matrix algebraization (Theorem 4): The matrices J_{ij}(tau) = <C_{tau,1}P_j, P_i> and E_{ij}(tau) = <C_{tau,1}P_j, C_{tau,1}P_i> vanish when i+j is odd, and for i+j even satisfy J_{ij}(tau) = 2*integral_{-1}^{1-tau} P_i(x)P_j(x+tau) dx and E_{ij}(tau) = 2*integral_{-1}^{1-tau} P_i(x)P_j(x) dx, both in Q[tau], computable by Legendre recurrence and exact polynomial arithmetic without quadrature.

Split residual Schur criterion (Theorem 5): For L=7/20, N_even=8 (d=16) or N_odd=6 (d=13), eta=1/2, if b_L = H_d - c_L - L_0 - kappa_L > 0 and b_L*F - R_eta is positive definite with R_eta = (1+eta)R_0 + (1+1/eta)R_2, then bar_q_{7/20}[w] >= L_0 ||w||^2 on the full closed-form domain of the parity sector.

Path A strict negative witnesses (Theorem 6): The rational Legendre vectors v_even = P_0 - P_2 and v_odd = P_1 - (1/2)P_3 certify (tilde_q - L_0*I)[v_even] in [-0.053384, -0.052711] and (tilde_q - L_0*I)[v_odd] in [-0.032327, -0.032119] with L_0 = 2^{-30} and theta=69/100. Path A is strictly falsified. This does not falsify FP-0.35.

Edge mass localization (L1): By Cauchy-Schwarz, |<C_{log2,L}v,v>| <= ||v||^2_{L^2(I_-)} + ||v||^2_{L^2(I_+)}, strictly localizing the prime danger term to boundary strips of total length 2*delta = 2*(2L - log2).

H^1_0 boundary layer rough bound (L2): For v in H^1_0(-L,L), the edge norm satisfies ||v||^2_{E_- union E_+} <= (4*delta^2/pi^2)(||v_prime||^2_{E_-} + ||v_prime||^2_{E_+}). This is a diagnostic lemma; the Weil form has only log-order coercivity and cannot directly absorb this bound.

Log endpoint absorption (L3): In the scaled model, ||w||^2_{L^2(E_- union E_+)} <= kappa_edge(L)^{-1} <Vw,w> with beta=0. Control of the edge strip requires only the endpoint potential V, not the full operator L = T + V.

PATH_A_REJECTED (meta-proposition): The weakened sufficient condition tilde_q_{7/20} >= L_0*I for theta=69/100 (potential redistribution without prime layer) is strictly false. Theorem 6 provides two explicit rational negative witnesses with interval-certified Arb values. This is a standalone repayable element; it does not affect the sign of bar_q_{7/20}.

O1-B even sector gate (conjecture): For L=7/20, N_even=8, tail_degree=16, eta=1/2, with frozen window log2 <= 2L < log3 verified, there exist interval-certified matrices M^(0), S^(0), M^(2), S^(2) and b_L > 0, b_L*F_even - R_eta_even > 0 (positive definite). Discovery pilot Schur margin ~8.81e-4.

O1-B odd sector gate (conjecture): For L=7/20, N_odd=6, tail_degree=13, eta=1/2, with frozen window log2 <= 2L < log3 verified, there exist interval-certified matrices M^(0), S^(0), M^(2), S^(2) and b_L > 0, b_L*F_odd - R_eta_odd > 0 (positive definite). Discovery pilot Schur margin ~3.44e-2.

FP-0.35 (main conjecture): lambda(7/20) = inf_{v != 0 in D(Q_W^{7/20})} Q_W^{7/20}(v) / ||v||^2 > 0. Equivalently, the local Weil quadratic form on L^2(-7/20, 7/20) is strictly positive. This is a finite-scale positivity statement and does not imply RH.
